name: Successful Build
description: Phase 3 — Construction. The build is green, quality thresholds are met and the Definition of Done is satisfied.

requiredArtifacts.validation: CI run green on main branch. No failing tests, no lint errors, no security scan failures

producedBy.note: The CI providers native run record (GitHub Actions run, GitLab job). Evolith reads the verdict and the run URL; inventing a schema here would restate what the provider already publishes and rot when it changes.

requiredArtifacts.validation: All Definition of Done items checked.
Updated ADRs, inline documentation, README changes included in merge
Business logic coverage >= 80% per Quality Thresholds rules

producedBy.note: Emitted by the coverage tool in its own long-standing format. A bespoke schema would force a lossy translation of something every reader already parses.
